text:
Platinum Price in 2005
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2005, the LBMA platinum price rose 11.0% between 2005-01-31 ($869) and 2005-12-29 ($965). The highest sampled price was $979 in November and the lowest was $860 in May. The mean of these observations was $900. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
